title: Renewal, Autoship and Transfer Terms by Tailwise Pharmacy Class
content:
For every Tailwise Pharmacy class this schedule records whether the pharmacy requests renewals by itself and how far ahead, whether the class may go on Autoship, and the transfer terms.

| Class | Pharmacy requests the renewal by itself | Renewal lead before expiry when fills remain | May be placed on Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | Transfer in allowed | Transfer out allowed | Transfers per prescription (in and out together) | Transfer needs at least one fill remaining |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | Yes | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | Yes | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes |
| Rx Prescription Diet | Yes | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | No | 0 calendar days | No | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes |
| Rx Controlled Substance | No | 7 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Rx Compounded Medication | Yes | 7 calendar days | Yes | No | No | 0 | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Pharmacy requests the renewal by itself**: whether the pharmacy requests a renewal from the veterinarian by itself when the prescription runs out or nears expiry.
- **Renewal lead**: calendar days before the expiry date at which an automatic renewal request is sent when fills remain.
- **Autoship**: whether the class may be placed on Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy.
- **Transfer in and out**: whether a prescription of the class may be transferred in from, or out to, another pharmacy.
- **Transfers per prescription**: transfers allowed over the life of one prescription, counting both in and out.
- **Fill remaining**: whether a transfer needs at least one fill remaining.

## Points of reading

- Rx Short-Course Medication and Rx Controlled Substance are the two classes whose renewals the pharmacy does not request by itself.
- Rx Short-Course Medication is the only class that cannot be placed on Autoship.
- Rx Compounded Medication prescriptions are never transferred in either direction; an Rx Controlled Substance prescription may be transferred once over its life.
